posts.title: Buying a Home? Don’t Skip a Termite Inspection in Melbourne
posts.excerpt: You have found the house. The location is great. The price feels right. The kitchen has been freshly renovated and the backyard is exactly what you wanted.
posts.content_html:
You have found the house. The location is great. The price feels right. The kitchen has been freshly renovated and the backyard is exactly what you wanted.

But before you sign anything, there is one thing a lot of Melbourne home buyers skip. And it is the one thing that can cost them tens of thousands of dollars after they move in.

A termite inspection.

It sounds like something you can deal with later. It is not. Termites are one of the most destructive pests in Australia, and Melbourne properties are not immune. By the time most homeowners realise there is a problem, the damage is already done and it is expensive to fix.

If you are buying a home, this is the one thing you cannot afford to skip.

Why Melbourne Homes Are at Risk

A lot of people assume termites are only a problem in Queensland or tropical parts of Australia. That is not true.

Melbourne’s climate creates plenty of conditions that termites love. Moisture around foundations, poor drainage, ageing timber structures, and older homes that were built without any termite protection in place. Suburbs across Melbourne, from the outer east to the inner west, have properties that have been quietly damaged by termites for years without the owners even knowing.

Subterranean termites are the most common species found in Melbourne. They live underground, build mud tunnels, and work their way into timber from below. They can chew through flooring, wall frames, roof beams, and support structures while leaving the surface looking completely normal.

That is what makes them so dangerous. You cannot see them working.

What Actually Happens During a Termite Inspection

A termite inspection is not just someone walking through your house having a quick look around. A proper termite inspection in Melbourne is a thorough check of the entire property carried out by a licensed termite specialist.

Here is what a good inspection covers.

The inspector checks all accessible areas of the property including the roof void, subfloor, internal rooms, external walls, fencing, garden beds, and any timber structures on the property like decks, pergolas, and sheds.

They use moisture meters to detect areas of high moisture that could attract termites. Thermal imaging cameras are sometimes used to spot activity behind walls without having to open them up. Tapping tools are used to check for hollow timber, which is a classic sign that termites have been feeding inside.

At the end, you get a written report that tells you exactly what was found, where any risk areas are, and what the recommended next steps are.

That report is something every Melbourne home buyer should have before settlement.

The Real Cost of Skipping an Inspection

Here is something worth thinking about carefully.

A termite inspection in Melbourne typically costs a few hundred dollars. It takes an hour or two. And it gives you a full picture of what you are buying.

Termite damage repair costs are a completely different story. Depending on how far the infestation has spread, repairs can run into the thousands or tens of thousands of dollars. Structural repairs to wall frames, flooring, roof timbers, and support beams are not cheap. And in serious cases, parts of the home may need to be completely rebuilt.

Home insurance in Australia generally does not cover termite damage either. It is considered a maintenance issue, not an insurable event. So if you buy a home and discover termite damage after settlement, that cost sits entirely with you.

A few hundred dollars upfront can save you a very unpleasant surprise after you move in.

What to Do If Termites Are Found

Finding termites during an inspection does not automatically mean you walk away from the property. But it does mean you need to go in with your eyes open.

If termites are discovered during an inspection, you have a few options. You can negotiate with the seller to have the termite treatment completed before settlement. You can factor the cost of termite control into your offer price. Or in some cases, if the damage is significant, you may decide the property is not worth the risk.

The key is that you know before you sign. That is the whole point of the inspection.

Once you do own the property, whether termites were found or not, putting a proper termite management plan in place is the smart move. This usually involves installing a termite barrier system around the perimeter of the property and scheduling annual termite inspections to catch any future activity early.

What Is a Termite Barrier and Do You Need One

A termite barrier is one of the most effective ways to protect a Melbourne property long term.

There are two main types. A chemical termite barrier involves treating the soil around and under the property with a product that either kills termites on contact or is carried back to the colony. A physical termite barrier is usually installed during construction and involves a layer of material that termites cannot pass through.

For existing homes, a chemical barrier is the most common solution. It is applied around the full perimeter of the property and under the slab where possible. When it is installed correctly by a licensed termite specialist, it provides solid long-term protection.

Most termite barriers need to be reapplied or inspected every few years to remain effective, which is why ongoing termite management in Melbourne is important rather than treating it as a one-off solution.

Signs to Watch for When Inspecting a Property Yourself

Even before you book a professional inspection, there are a few things worth looking for when you walk through a property.

Mud tubes along walls, foundations, or inside cupboards are a strong indicator of subterranean termite activity. These are small tunnels made of soil and timber particles that termites build to travel between the ground and their food source.

Timber that sounds hollow when you knock on it is another warning sign. Termites eat timber from the inside, leaving a thin shell behind that collapses when pressed.

Doors and windows that have started to stick or warp without an obvious reason can sometimes be caused by termite damage affecting the surrounding frames.

Small piles of what looks like sawdust or tiny pellets near timber structures can also indicate activity.

If you spot any of these things during a property walkthrough, make sure a qualified termite specialist in Melbourne takes a proper look before you go any further.

Getting the Right Help in Melbourne

posts.content_html:
Finding a rat in your home is enough to make anyone’s heart skip a beat. You might see a dark shape scurrying across the kitchen floor at night or hear a strange scratching sound in the walls while you’re trying to sleep. Your first thought might be, “It’s just one. Maybe it wandered in by mistake and will leave on its own.”

Unfortunately, when it comes to rats in Melbourne, there is rarely such a thing as “just one.” In the world of pest control, a single sighting is often the tip of the iceberg. If you are worried about your budget, you might hesitate to call for help, but finding affordable rodent control early is the best way to prevent a minor nuisance from becoming a full-scale household disaster.

Let’s look at the truth about how rats live, how fast they multiply, and why you should act immediately.

The Myth of the “Lonely Rat”

Rats are highly social creatures. They don’t like to live alone. In the wild, and especially in urban areas like Melbourne, rats live in family groups or colonies. If a rat has found its way into your pantry or laundry room, it’s usually because it followed a scent trail left by another rat, or it’s scouting for a place where its family can nest.

If you see one rat, it usually means there are others nearby—either on the roof, under the floorboards, or just outside in the garden waiting for an opening. This is why waiting to see if the problem “goes away” usually leads to more trouble.

The Math of a Rat Infestation

To understand why you need to act fast, you have to look at the numbers. Rats are reproductive machines.

A female rat can have up to 5 to 10 litters per year. Each litter can have anywhere from 6 to 12 babies. Even more shocking? Those babies are ready to start breeding themselves in just a few months.

If you have a male and a female rat hiding in your walls, they could technically produce dozens of offspring in a single season. This is why people who search for affordable rodent control early save so much money. It is much cheaper to deal with a couple of “scouts” than it is to clear out a colony of fifty rats that have taken over your attic.

Why Melbourne Homes Are at Risk

Melbourne is a beautiful city, but our combination of older suburban homes, leafy gardens, and busy urban centers makes it a paradise for rodents. Rats love the weather here. When it gets cold or rainy, they look for the warmth of a human home.

They can squeeze through a hole the size of a thumb. Once they are in, they have everything they need: warmth, shelter, and a nearby food source (like your kitchen or even your pet’s bowl). Without professional intervention, they have no reason to leave.

Signs You Have More Than One Guest

If you aren’t sure if that one rat has friends, look for these common signs:

  1. Droppings: Small, dark, capsule-shaped droppings are a clear giveaway. If you see different sizes of droppings, it means you have both adults and young rats—a definite sign of a breeding colony.
  2. Gnaw Marks: Rats have teeth that never stop growing. To keep them down, they chew on everything. This includes wood, plastic, and—most dangerously—electrical wiring.
  3. Noises at Night: Rats are nocturnal. If you hear “pitter-patter” sounds or scratching in the ceiling after the sun goes down, you aren’t alone.
  4. Smell: A settled infestation has a very specific, musky ammonia smell. If you can smell it, the problem is already significant.

If you notice any of these, searching for affordable rodent control should be your top priority. You don’t want to wait until the damage to your home becomes expensive to repair.

Expert Help: Why Choose 7 States Pest Control?

When the DIY traps aren’t cutting it and you need a permanent solution, 7 States Pest Control is the name Melbourne residents trust. We specialize in identifying the unique behaviors of local rodents and providing a service that actually works.

At 7 States Pest Control, we believe that every family deserves a safe, pest-free home without having to spend their entire savings. We provide high-quality, professional treatments that focus on long-term results. We don’t just put down a few baits and leave; we look at the “big picture” of your property to make sure those rats stay out for good.

Our team is local, friendly, and understands the specific pest challenges faced by Melbourne homeowners. When you choose us for affordable rodent control, you are getting expert technicians who use the latest, safest methods to protect your space.

The Hidden Dangers of Ignoring the Problem

It’s not just about the “ick” factor. Rats pose real risks to your home and your health.

  1. Health Risks

Rats carry diseases that can be spread through their droppings, urine, or even through the fleas and ticks that live on them. They crawl over kitchen benches and inside cupboards, leaving behind bacteria like Salmonella.

  1. Fire Hazards

As mentioned before, rats love to chew on wires. Every year, house fires in Melbourne are linked to rodents chewing through electrical insulation behind walls. This is a “hidden” cost that makes the price of affordable rodent control seem like a very smart investment.

  1. Structural Damage

Rats can ruin insulation, chew through plasterboard, and damage expensive furniture. The longer they stay, the more they destroy.

Can You Solve It Yourself?

Many homeowners try the DIY route first. They buy a few traps from the local hardware store and hope for the best. While a trap might catch the one rat you saw, it rarely solves the underlying problem.

Professional services like 7 States Pest Control understand rat behavior. We don’t just kill one rat; we find the entry points, identify the nesting areas, and ensure the whole “family” is gone. Many people find that by the time they spend money on retail sprays and baits that don’t work, they could have already paid for affordable rodent control and had the peace of mind that the job was done right.

Finding Affordable Rodent Control in Melbourne

We understand that everyone is watching their spending these days. You might worry that calling a professional will cost a fortune. However, pest control technology has come a long way.

Today, you can find affordable rodent control that is effective, safe for your pets, and won’t break the bank. With 7 States Pest Control, you get:

  • A clear, honest inspection of your property.
  • A plan to “build them out” (closing entry holes).
  • Safe baiting or trapping methods that protect your family.
  • Professional advice on preventing future visitors.

Investing in affordable rodent control now means you won’t be paying for an emergency “infestation cleanout” six months from now.

How to Keep Them Out for Good

Once 7 States Pest Control has cleared the rats out, you want to keep them away. Here are a few simple tips:

  • Seal the Gaps: Use steel wool or metal mesh to plug holes around pipes.
  • Clean the Kitchen: Don’t leave crumbs on the floor or food out overnight.
  • Secure Pet Food: Keep dog kibble in airtight metal containers.
  • Manage Your Garden: Keep bushes trimmed away from the house.
Don’t Wait for the Crowd

If you saw a rat today, don’t wait until you see five next week. The “truth” is that one rat is almost always a sign of a bigger story unfolding behind your walls.

Taking action today is the best thing you can do for your home. By choosing 7 States Pest Control for affordable rodent control, you can protect your property from the risks that these unwanted guests bring.

Remember, a home should be a place for people, not pests. If you’re worried about the cost, just remember that affordable rodent control is much cheaper than replacing the wiring in your roof.

Keep your home safe and rodent-free. 

If you’ve spotted a furry intruder, contact 7 States Pest Control today for the best affordable rodent control Melbourne has to offer. You’ll sleep a lot better knowing you’re the only one moving around in the dark.

posts.content_html:
Finding an affordable pest control service without compromising on quality is something many homeowners in Melbourne strive for. Pest problems can vary greatly, from ants and termites to rodents and birds. 

While it’s important to address these issues promptly, the cost of treatment often raises concerns. The good news is that cheap pest control services are available—if you know how to choose the right provider.

However, not every affordable service delivers the same results. While many companies offer cheap pest control, not all of them provide effective, long-lasting solutions. 

In this blog, we’ll guide you through key factors to consider when searching for affordable pest control and highlight what to watch out for to ensure you get value for your money.

Choosing the right pest control service can be tricky, especially when trying to balance affordability with quality. 

To help you make an informed decision, it’s important to know what factors contribute to a reliable and cost-effective service, as well as which red flags to watch for.

Look for Professional Experience and Reputation

When choosing a pest control service, experience and reputation are essential. A company with years of experience is more likely to have refined its methods and earned a solid reputation in the local community. 

Take time to read reviews and ask for recommendations from family, friends, or neighbours. Companies with a strong reputation are typically more trustworthy and are better equipped to handle various pest problems.

A business with an established track record has likely developed effective methods to solve pest problems. 

This is particularly important when dealing with specialised issues, such as solar panel bird proofing or termite control. An experienced company will have the tools and knowledge to tackle even the most persistent infestations.

Understand What’s Included in the Price

Cheap pest control services can be enticing, but it’s crucial to clarify exactly what is included in the quoted price. 

A low price may appear appealing, but it can sometimes be misleading if the service doesn’t cover everything you need. Always request a detailed breakdown of the service to understand what you’re paying for.

Does the price include an initial inspection, follow-up visits, or treatments for specific pests? These are critical details to clarify before moving forward with any service. 

By ensuring you understand all charges upfront, you can avoid unexpected costs that may arise later. Transparency about pricing can help you make the best decision without any surprises.

Look for Customised Solutions

Every pest problem is unique, and the best pest control services will offer tailored solutions, not a generic one-size-fits-all approach. 

For example, bird control for solar panels requires specific techniques, which differ from the methods used to remove termites from a building’s foundation.

Good pest control companies take the time to assess your particular situation and offer solutions that suit the needs of your home or business. 

This personalized approach ensures the treatment is effective and saves you from paying for services you don’t need. A customised plan will target your pest issues directly and improve the chances of successful control.

Avoid Services That Use Harmful Chemicals

One mistake some homeowners make when choosing cheap pest control services is selecting companies that rely on harmful chemicals to treat infestations. 

While these chemicals may provide quick fixes, they can be dangerous to both your health and the environment.

When discussing pest control options, always ask the company about the types of products they use. Ideally, choose a provider that uses eco-friendly or non-toxic solutions to ensure the safety of your family, pets, and the environment. 

Make sure that the chemicals are effective but won’t pose unnecessary risks. Eco-friendly options are an essential consideration when selecting a pest control provider that aligns with your values and health priorities.

Ensure the Service Offers Long-Term Solutions

While some cheap pest control services might only offer a quick fix, pest problems tend to return if they aren’t treated properly. 

It’s important to look for companies that focus on long-term solutions, addressing the root cause of the infestation and providing preventative measures to keep pests away for good.

A reliable pest control company will not only solve the immediate problem but also offer follow-up visits and advice to prevent future infestations. 

They may provide services with guarantees, helping you feel confident in the effectiveness of their treatment. Long-term pest control is an investment that can save you money and stress in the future by reducing the frequency of treatments.

A company with good customer support will address any issues promptly and ensure your satisfaction throughout the process.

Choose a pest control provider that offers easy communication and quick response times. The ability to reach them when you need assistance or have follow-up questions is essential for peace of mind. 

A dependable customer service team will make your pest control experience smoother, ensuring the job is done right the first time.

Make the Right Choice for Your Home

Instead, focus on finding a service that offers a combination of experience, tailored solutions, safe products, long-term results, and excellent customer service.

posts.content_html:
Bed bugs are every property owner’s nightmare. 

Whether you’re a homeowner, renter, landlord, or manage a hotel in Melbourne, an infestation can quickly spiral out of control, damaging your peace of mind, property, or business reputation. 

If you’re searching for bed bug pest control price in Melbourne, you’re likely wondering how much it costs and what treatment offers the best value for your money.

In this blog, we’ll break down the factors that influence bed bug pest control prices, compare treatment options, and help you decide what’s best for your situation.

Why Bed Bug Pest Control Prices Change in Melbourne

Not all bed bug infestations are the same, and neither are the costs to treat them. 

The price of bed bug pest control in Melbourne depends on several factors. 

Understanding these can help homeowners, renters, property managers, and hotel owners budget effectively while ensuring complete eradication.

Size of the Infestation

A small infestation in one bedroom will cost less to treat than a widespread problem across multiple rooms or an entire hotel. 

The more areas affected—think mattresses, couches, carpets, and bed frames—the higher the price.

Property Type and Size

A single-bedroom rental unit is cheaper to treat than a Widespread family home or a multi-room motel. Larger properties require more time, labour, and materials, driving up the cost.

Treatment Method

From heat treatments to chemical sprays and steam applications, the method you choose impacts the price. Some treatments are more labour-intensive or require specialised equipment, which can increase costs.

Follow-Up Visits

Bed bugs are tough to get rid of and keep coming back. Some infestations need multiple treatments to make sure they’re gone for good, adding to the overall price.

How Much Does Bed Bug Pest Control Cost in Melbourne?

For Melbourne homeowners, renters, and businesses, bed bug pest control prices typically range from $299 to $800 or more, depending on the factors above. Here’s a breakdown of what you can expect:

  • Basic Treatment (Small Infestation): Starting at $299
     Ideal for early-stage infestations in a single room. This might include treating a bed frame and mattress with a combination of steam and residual sprays.
  • Moderate Infestation (Multiple Rooms): $400–$600
     Covers larger homes or rentals with infestations in mattresses, couches, and carpets. May involve heat or chemical treatments.
  • Severe Infestation (Hotels or Large Properties): $600–$800+
     For businesses like hotels, motels, or hostels where guest satisfaction and reputation are at stake, comprehensive treatments across multiple rooms are essential.

Types of Bed Bug Treatments and Their Costs

Choosing the right treatment is key to balancing effectiveness and affordability. Here’s a look at the most common bed bug pest control methods available in Melbourne, along with their price ranges:

  1. Chemical Treatments
  • Price Range: $299–$500
  • How It Works: Professional-grade Bug spray are applied to affected areas like bed frames, mattresses, and carpets.
  • Best For: Cost-conscious homeowners and renters with small to medium infestations.
  • Pros: Affordable and widely available.
  • Cons: May require multiple visits for complete eradication.
  1. Heat Treatments
  • Price Range: $400–$800
  • How It Works: Specialised equipment raises the room temperature to kill bed bugs and their eggs.
  • Best For: Hotels, motels, and larger properties needing fast, thorough results.
  • Pros: Highly effective, often a one-time treatment.
  • Cons: Higher upfront cost and not suitable for all properties.
  1. Steam Treatments
  • Price Range: $350–$600
  • How It Works: High-temperature steam is used to penetrate fabrics and kill bed bugs on contact.
  • Best For: Landlords and property managers treating furniture like couches and mattresses.
  • Pros: Eco-friendly and safe for sensitive areas.
  • Cons: Labour-intensive, which can increase costs.
  1. Combination Treatments
  • Price Range: $500–$800+
  • How It Works: A mix of chemical, heat, and steam methods for maximum impact.
  • Best For: Severe infestations in hotels or homes where failure isn’t an option.
  • Pros: Detailed and long-lasting.
  • Cons: Most expensive option.
Why Invest in Professional Bed Bug Pest Control?

For cost-conscious customers, DIY solutions like sprays or bed bug bombs might seem tempting. 

However, these rarely address the root of the problem and can end up costing more in the long run. Here’s why professional pest control is worth the investment:

  • Expertise: Trained technicians know how to spot and treat hidden infestations.
  • Guaranteed Results: Reputable companies offer follow-ups to Make sure bed bugs don’t return.
  • Reputation Protection: For hotels and landlords, keeping guests and residents happy means making sure there are no pests around. 
  • Time Savings: Professionals handle the job quickly and efficiently, so you don’t have to.

Melbourne’s humid climate makes it a hotspot for bed bugs, so acting fast with expert help is crucial.

Tips to Reduce Bed Bug Pest Control Costs

Want to keep prices low without sacrificing results? Try these practical steps:

  1. Act Early: Address infestations at the first sign—small problems are cheaper to fix.
  2. Prepare Your Space: Wash Sheets , vacuum carpets, and Organize to make the technician’s job easier.
  3. Compare Quotes: Get estimates from multiple providers, but prioritise quality over the cheapest option.
  4. Ask About Packages: Some companies offer discounts for combined treatments or follow-ups.
Choosing the Right Pest Control Service in Melbourne

With so many options, how do you pick a provider that delivers value for your money? Look for:

  • Experience: Choose a company with a proven track record in bed bug treatments.
  • Transparent Pricing: Avoid hidden fees—opt for clear, upfront quotes.
  • Local Knowledge: Melbourne-based teams understand the area’s pest challenges.
  • Customer Reviews: Check testimonials from homeowners, landlords, and businesses.

At 7 States Pest Control, we tick all these boxes, offering professional bed bug treatments starting at $299 with a focus on customer satisfaction.

Take Control of Bed Bugs Today

Bed bugs don’t Separate —they can invade homes, rentals, hotels, and motels alike.

Pest control costs can differ, but hiring professionals is the best way to protect your property, reputation, and money.

Whether you’re a homeowner battling a mattress infestation or a hotel owner safeguarding guest satisfaction, finding the right bed bug pest control price and solution is within reach.

Ready to say goodbye to bed bugs?

posts.content_html:
You open the cupboard or wardrobe, and suddenly a spider crawls out. It’s a scene that plays out in many Melbourne homes, especially during the warmer months. While some may ignore the occasional spider sighting, repeated appearances can be unsettling and even dangerous.

Melbourne’s climate and urban setting create ideal conditions for spiders to thrive, particularly when indoor spaces offer them warmth, shelter, and food. 

With kids, elderly people, or pets in the house, spider infestations can go from irritating to risky in no time.

This blog will help you understand why spiders invade homes, which species to watch out for, and why professional spider control and removal services in Melbourne are the most reliable solution to keep your space pest-free.

Why Are Spiders Entering Your Home?

 

Spiders enter homes for three main reasons: food, shelter, and breeding. Here’s what might be attracting them to your space:

  • Moisture and Insects: Kitchens, bathrooms, and basements often have higher humidity and an abundance of insects—a feast for spiders.
  • Cluttered Storage Spaces: Wardrobes, laundry rooms, and under sinks are perfect hiding spots.
  • Openings and Cracks: Gaps in windows, doors, vents, and floorboards allow easy access.
  • Weather Changes: Spiders are more active in summer and post-rainy seasons when insects multiply.

A small spider problem can quickly escalate if these conditions aren’t addressed.

Common Spider Species Found in Melbourne Homes

Understanding which spiders you’re dealing with is key to managing an infestation effectively. Here are the most common species in Melbourne homes:

  • Redback Spiders: Recognised by the red stripe on their back. Often hide in sheds, under furniture, and near outdoor steps. Their bite is venomous and requires medical attention.
  • White-Tailed Spiders: Grey with a white tip on the tail, these spiders are known for causing painful bites and skin irritations. Often found in clothing and linen.
  • Daddy Long Legs: Harmless to humans, but their webs indicate other insects are present—which attracts more spiders.
  • Huntsman Spiders: Large, fast-moving, and usually non-aggressive. While not dangerous, their size and speed can be alarming.

Each of these species behaves differently, and a proper identification can help determine the best removal strategy.

Why DIY Spider Solutions Often Fail

Many homeowners try DIY sprays or repellents from hardware stores, but these rarely provide lasting results. Here’s why:

  • Limited Coverage: DIY methods don’t reach into wall cavities, behind appliances, or deep storage zones.
  • Eggs Remain Untouched: Killing one spider doesn’t stop the next generation. Egg sacs can hold dozens of spiders.

posts.title: Do I Need Rodent Control After Renovation? The Truth You Must Know
posts.excerpt: You just renovated your dream home—but something’s scratching in the walls? That fresh paint smell, new flooring, and improved space feel great. posts.content_html:
You just renovated your dream home—but something’s scratching in the walls?

That fresh paint smell, new flooring, and improved space feel great. But right after renovation, your home is also more vulnerable to a hidden problem many homeowners don’t see coming: rodents.

While renovations bring aesthetic improvements, they can also create the perfect conditions for pests. Mice and rats are always looking for new shelter, warmth, and access to food—and post-reno homes provide all of that and more.

Wondering if you need cheap rodent control after a renovation? The short answer is yes—and in this article, we’ll explain why it’s one of the smartest post-reno investments you can make.

How Renovation Attracts Rodents

You may not notice it during the excitement of construction, but renovations often stir up more than dust. Rodents living nearby—whether in walls, roofs, or garden sheds—can be displaced during the process.

At the same time, the work itself can unintentionally make your home more accessible to pests. 

Here’s how:

  1. Disturbed Nesting Sites

Demolition or landscaping may force rodents out of their original hiding spots. With parts of your home open or exposed, they may simply move closer—in some cases, right inside your walls or roof.

  1. New Entry Points

Common during renovations, openings for plumbing, electrical wiring, or vent installation can leave small gaps behind. Even holes the size of a 20-cent coin are enough for a mouse to squeeze through.

  1. Construction Debris and Food Scraps

Rodents are opportunistic. If your contractor or trades leave behind crumbs, food wrappers, or waste in bins or around the site, that’s a buffet to them.

  1. Increased Warmth and Shelter

Fresh insulation, new wall cavities, or enclosed decks create comfortable, quiet spaces—ideal for nesting. Once inside, rodents are quick to settle and even quicker to breed.

Renovating your home can be an exciting time, but if you’re not careful, it can also invite in unwanted guests that stay long after the work is finished.

Hidden Rodent Entry Points Created During Renovation

Rodents don’t need a front door. They look for gaps, cracks, or vulnerabilities you may not even notice.

Here are some of the most common rodent entry points introduced during renovation:

  • Foundation cracks
    Even hairline cracks in your foundation can provide entry from underneath your home.
  • Gaps in rooflines or under tiles
    Roof work often involves removing and replacing sections—leaving tiny gaps where rodents can climb in.
  • Openings around new plumbing or electrical installations
    Pipes and wires often go through walls and floors. If not sealed properly, these become rodent highways.
  • Crawlspaces, skirting boards, and wall cavities
    If left open during renovations, these provide easy access to interior spaces.

Tip: Take photos during the renovation process and label potential weak spots. You can use these later to help your pest control expert identify entry points faster.

Real Dangers of Ignoring Rodent Control After Renovation

Rodents aren’t just a nuisance. Left unchecked, they can pose serious health and safety risks:

Chewed Wires = Fire Risk

Rodents love to gnaw—and electrical wires are a prime target. This kind of damage isn’t just annoying; it can lead to short circuits and even house fires.

Contaminated Food Storage

Mice and rats often invade kitchens, pantries, and food containers. Their presence can result in contaminated food, and exposure to harmful bacteria such as salmonella.

Urine and Droppings = Health Hazards

Rodent droppings and urine can trigger allergic reactions and spread diseases like leptospirosis and hantavirus.

Rapid Breeding

A single pair of rodents can produce dozens of offspring in a short time. An unnoticed rodent family can turn into a full-blown infestation within weeks.

Signs You Might Already Have a Rodent Problem

You might not see the rodents themselves, but they leave clues. Here’s what to look (and listen) for:

  • Scratching or scurrying sounds in walls, ceilings, or under floors—usually at night
  • Rodent droppings, especially near food areas, bins, or behind appliances
  • Gnaw marks on timber, wiring, or plastic fixtures
  • Nesting material like shredded insulation or paper in wall cavities or storage areas

If you spot one or more of these signs, it’s likely time to take action.

Why Cheap Rodent Control Is the Smartest Post-Reno Investment

You’ve spent good money improving your home—so don’t let rodents undermine it. 

Hiring a pest control service immediately after renovation may feel like an extra cost, but it actually saves you money and stress in the long run.

Here’s why post-reno rodent control is a smart move:

  • Prevent serious damage before it starts
  • Avoid expensive repairs from chewed wires, damaged insulation, or wall cavities
  • Protect your health and that of your family
  • Catch infestations early, while they’re still manageable
  • Get expert advice tailored to your new layout
What a Professional Rodent Inspection Includes

A quality inspection looks beyond surface-level signs. Professional pest control teams know exactly where to look and what to look for.

Here’s what a comprehensive rodent inspection usually includes:

  • Checking for entry points in foundations, roofs, and utility lines
  • Identifying nests using heat and scent detection or visual inspection
  • Assessing potential damage to insulation, wiring, and internal structures
  • Applying safe, targeted removal methods that won’t harm pets or family
  • Providing proofing advice to keep rodents from returning
Is Your Renovated Space Rodent-Safe?

Before settling into your new space, go through this quick post-renovation rodent-proofing checklist:

  • Sealed all visible gaps in walls, floors, and ceilings
  • Checked roof and attic access points
  • Removed all leftover food and rubbish
  • Inspected under sinks and around new appliances
  • Scheduled a professional rodent inspection

If anything is left unchecked, your home could be at risk. It’s far easier to prevent a rodent problem than to get rid of one once it takes hold.

Renovation is an exciting step in homeownership. But while you’re focused on paint colours and tiles, rodents are looking for cracks and cavities. The dust may settle, but the risks can remain—unless you take action.

That’s where 7 States Pest Control comes in. Based in Melbourne, 7 States Pest Control offers fast, affordable, and reliable pest management services tailored to your home’s layout—especially after renovation. 

Their licensed technicians are experienced in identifying new pest entry points and providing cheap rodent control solutions that are safe, targeted, and effective.

Don’t let mice or rats damage what you’ve built. Even the most beautifully renovated homes in Melbourne can fall victim to pests if entry points are left unsealed or food sources are accessible.

The good news? Preventing an infestation doesn’t have to be expensive. Cheap rodent control services are available that offer thorough inspections, targeted treatment, and long-term protection—without breaking the bank.

Protect your home investment—book your rodent inspection now. An affordable post-renovation pest check could be the smartest step you take after your build.

posts.content_html:
In Melbourne, the warmer months often bring with them a surge in wasp activity. Wasps, while beneficial to the environment in their role as natural pest controllers, can quickly become a nuisance when they decide to build their nests in and around your home. The growing presence of wasps in Melbourne homes has made effective wasp control an essential service.

If you’re looking for reliable wasp control in Melbourne, understanding the signs of infestation is crucial. 

Early detection of wasp nests not only helps in preventing harm to humans and pets but also avoids extensive property damage. 

In this blog, we will explore why wasp infestations are dangerous, the common signs that indicate a growing problem, and how professional wasp control melbourne can ensure safe removal.

Why Wasp Infestations Can Be Dangerous

Risks to Humans and Pets

Wasp stings can cause significant pain, and for some individuals, they can lead to severe allergic reactions. Anaphylaxis due to a wasp sting can be life-threatening and requires immediate medical attention. Even if you are not allergic, multiple stings can cause localized swelling, intense pain, and discomfort.

Pets, particularly dogs and cats, are also vulnerable to wasp stings. Since pets are naturally curious, they may try to interact with wasps, leading to painful consequences. In Melbourne, there have been numerous reports of pets being stung by wasps, especially in gardens where wasp nests are commonly found.

Property Damage Risks

Wasp nests are often constructed in sheltered areas such as roof eaves, sheds, and wall cavities. Over time, these nests can lead to structural damage. Wasps use wood fibers, which they chew and mix with saliva to build their nests. This chewing can weaken structural elements like eaves or beams, leading to expensive repairs.

In Melbourne, homes with attic spaces or outdoor sheds are particularly at risk, as these areas provide ideal nesting sites for wasps. By the time an infestation reaches its peak, the damage could be extensive.

Common Signs of a Growing Wasp Infestation

Recognizing the early signs of a wasp infestation can help prevent larger issues down the road. Here are some common signs that your home may be dealing with a wasp problem:

Visible Nests

The most obvious sign of a wasp infestation is the presence of nests around your property. Wasps typically build their nests in hidden areas such as roof eaves, garden sheds, or trees. 

The nests are often made from chewed wood fibers and can vary in size, depending on the age of the nest and the size of the colony. If you spot a nest, it’s crucial to act quickly before the wasps become more aggressive.

Increased Wasp Activity

Another sign of an infestation is the increased activity of wasps around your property. If you begin to notice large numbers of wasps flying around your garden, near your home’s entrance, or near any potential nesting sites, it could indicate a larger infestation. 

Wasps are most active during the day, so you may also see them returning to their nests late in the afternoon or early evening.

Buzzing Sounds

Wasps often make a buzzing noise as they work within their nests. If you hear buzzing sounds coming from your walls, attic, or roof spaces, it could be a sign that a nest is hidden within the structure of your home. 

This is particularly concerning as it suggests that the infestation is not easily visible, and professional intervention will likely be needed.

Aggressive Behaviour

As a wasp colony grows, its aggression can increase. If you notice that wasps are becoming more aggressive, or if you experience frequent attacks when you venture outside, it could be a sign that the colony is getting too large. 

Wasps become more protective of their nests as the season progresses, especially during late summer and autumn.

Physical Damage

Wasps will often chew through materials such as wood, insulation, and even plant materials to build and expand their nests. If you notice unusual damage to wooden surfaces, holes in your garden plants, or chewed insulation in your attic, these could be signs of a wasp infestation.

Seasonal Patterns of Wasps in Melbourne

Wasp activity is generally seasonal, with infestations being most common during the spring and summer months. 

As the weather warms, queen wasps start to build nests, and by late summer and early autumn, the nests can reach their peak size. At this point, the wasps are most active, and the risk of stings and property damage increases.

Understanding the life cycle of wasps is crucial. Wasps start as small colonies during the spring and gradually expand as the season progresses. 

By the time the colony reaches its peak in late summer, the wasps are at their most active and aggressive. This is the time when professional wasp control in Melbourne becomes essential to prevent major issues.

DIY Measures vs Professional Wasp Control in Melbourne

DIY Precautions

While some homeowners may attempt to deal with a small wasp problem using DIY methods such as traps or sprays, these solutions are often ineffective and can be dangerous. Attempting to remove a wasp nest yourself can provoke the colony, leading to aggressive behaviour and an increased risk of stings.

Professional Wasp Control

 

Professional wasp control Melbourne services provide safe, permanent solutions. Expert pest control technicians are trained to handle wasp infestations efficiently and safely, using specialized equipment and techniques to remove nests. Professional services also ensure that the nests are completely eradicated, reducing the risk of reinfestation.

Hiring experienced professionals is essential for ensuring the safety of your family and pets, as well as protecting your property from potential damage.

Steps to Take if You Suspect a Wasp Infestation

If you suspect a wasp infestation, it’s important to act immediately:

  1. Don’t attempt to remove the nest yourself – This can provoke the wasps and increase the risk of stings.
  2. Call professional pest control immediately – A licensed pest control expert will know how to safely handle the situation.
  3. Keep children and pets away – Wasps can become aggressive when disturbed, so it’s essential to keep your family and pets at a safe distance.
Why Choose 7 States Pest Control for Wasp Removal in Melbourne

Years of Experience and Licensed Professionals

With years of experience in the field, 7 States Pest Control has built a reputation for reliable, safe, and effective wasp removal in Melbourne. Our licensed technicians have the expertise to manage and eliminate even the most challenging infestations.

Safe, Eco-Friendly Methods

We prioritize the use of eco-friendly and safe methods for wasp control in Melbourne, ensuring that both your home and the environment remain unharmed.

Quick Response and Effective Eradication

At 7 States Pest Control, we understand the urgency of removing wasp nests. Our team offers quick, effective solutions to eliminate the infestation and restore peace to your home.

Identifying the signs of a wasp infestation early is crucial for preventing serious health risks, property damage, and discomfort. Professional wasp control in Melbourne is the best way to ensure that your home remains safe and free of wasps. If you notice any of the warning signs of an infestation, don’t hesitate to contact 7 States Pest Control for fast, effective, and professional removal services.

posts.excerpt: Silverfish – those silvery, fast-moving insects – might seem harmless, but they can become a nuisance in your Melbourne home.  While they don’t bite or transmit diseases, they can damage books, wallpaper, and other belongings that contain starch or cellulose.  Here at 7 States Pest Control, we understand the frustration
posts.content_html:
Silverfish – those silvery, fast-moving insects – might seem harmless, but they can become a nuisance in your Melbourne home.  While they don’t bite or transmit diseases, they can damage books, wallpaper, and other belongings that contain starch or cellulose.  Here at 7 States Pest Control, we understand the frustration of silverfish infestations.

This blog post dives into silverfish control in Melbourne, covering their characteristics, signs of infestation, and the benefits of professional silverfish treatment in Melbourne.

Signs of a Silverfish Infestation

Before we delve into the signs, let’s get to know these little critters. Silverfish are wingless insects with elongated, flattened bodies. They typically measure around half an inch long and have a silvery-gray color, earning them their name. These nocturnal creatures prefer dark, humid environments and are most active at night.

While you might not see the silverfish themselves very often, there are several signs that can alert you to their presence:

  • Live or Dead Silverfish: This is the most obvious sign, but due to their nocturnal nature, you might only see them scurrying across the floor at night or hiding in dark corners.
  • Cast Skins: As silverfish grow, they shed their outer skin. These shed skins are usually light yellow or brown and about the size of the actual insect. You might find them near baseboards, in cracks and crevices, or behind furniture.
  • Holes in Fabrics and Paper Products: Silverfish feed on starchy and cellulose-based materials. This means they can damage your clothes, books, wallpaper, and even cardboard boxes. Look for small, irregular holes in these items.
  • Yellowish Staining: Silverfish droppings are tiny and dark, but they can leave behind yellowish stains on fabrics or surfaces they frequent.

Why Choose Professional Silverfish Treatment in Melbourne?

While DIY methods might seem tempting, professional silverfish treatment offers several advantages:

  • Effective Control: DIY methods often only address adult silverfish, leaving eggs and nymphs behind to continue the infestation. Professionals use targeted treatments to eliminate all life stages.
  • Identifying the Source: Professionals can identify entry points and moisture issues that attract silverfish, allowing for long-term solutions.
  • Safe and Efficient Treatment: We use safe and effective EPA-approved products to eliminate silverfish while minimizing disruption to your home.
  • Peace of Mind: Professional treatment ensures a complete elimination, allowing you to enjoy a silverfish-free home without worry.

At 7 States Pest Control, we offer effective and safe silverfish control solutions for Melbourne homes. Our experienced technicians will assess your situation, identify the source of the infestation, and implement a targeted treatment plan to eliminate the silverfish problem.

posts.title: Keep Rodents From Making Your Home Their Home This Winter
posts.excerpt: As the days get colder and the nights grow longer, the cozy appeal of our homes isn’t just for us – it’s also attractive to unwanted guests: pests. Among these unwelcome visitors, rodents like mice and rats are particularly common during winter. Their natural instinct is to seek shelter from
posts.content_html:
As the days get colder and the nights grow longer, the cozy appeal of our homes isn’t just for us – it’s also attractive to unwanted guests: pests. Among these unwelcome visitors, rodents like mice and rats are particularly common during winter. Their natural instinct is to seek shelter from the harsh and unpredictable winter weather, and unfortunately, your warm and comfortable home can become an ideal haven for them.

But don’t worry, by taking some proactive steps including pest control services, you can keep your home rodent-free and enjoy your winter in peace.

Understanding Winter Pest Invasion

While the Australian winter is generally mild compared to colder climates, it still poses challenges for rodents seeking warmth and sustenance. This is why we see an increase in rodent activity during this season. Here’s what you need to understand about winter pest invasions:

  • Seeking Shelter: As mentioned earlier, rodents are driven to find warm and secure shelters during winter. They’ll actively search for any openings in your home, such as cracks in the foundation, gaps around pipes, or unsealed vents.
  • Food Source: Rodents need a reliable food source to survive the winter. Your home, with its readily available food scraps, crumbs, and pet food, becomes an attractive option for them. Additionally, overflowing bins, compost heaps, and accessible fruit trees near your house can attract them further.
  • Increased Activity: As the temperatures drop, rodents become more active in their search for shelter and food. You may notice increased noises in the walls or attic, droppings around your home, and even gnaw marks on furniture or wires.

5 Effective Ways To Keep Rodents Away From Your Home

Here are five effective steps you can take to keep rodents at bay this winter:

1. Seal Entry Points: Fortifying Your Home Against Unwanted Guests:

Imagine your home as a fortress. Your first line of defense is ensuring there are no sealing cracks, holes, or gaps around doors, windows, pipes, and foundation. Even a tiny opening can be enough for a determined rodent to squeeze through.

  • Inspect your home thoroughly: Look for potential entry points outside your house, paying close attention to areas around pipes, vents, and the foundation. Inside, check for gaps around doors, windows, and any other openings.
  • Seal the gaps: Use caulk to fill any cracks or holes you find. For larger openings, consider using steel wool or hardware cloth to create a barrier that rodents can’t chew through. Don’t forget to seal gaps around dryer vents and any holes in your chimney.

2. Trim Trees And Shrubs: Eliminating Rodent Access Points Near Your Home:

Rodents are skilled climbers and can use overhanging trees and shrubs as bridges to reach your roof and eventually gain access to your home. Here’s what you can do:

  • Keep trees and shrubs trimmed: Maintain a distance of at least six feet between tree branches and your roof. This will discourage rodents from using them as stepping stones.
  • Clear away debris: Remove any piles of leaves, branches, or other debris near your house. These can provide rodents with hiding places and make your home more attractive to them.

3. Store Food Properly: Removing Temptations For Hungry Invaders:

Rodents are always on the lookout for food, and any readily available sources will attract them to your home. Here are some tips:

  • Store food in airtight containers: This applies to all food items, including cereals, grains, pet food, and even snacks. Don’t leave food sitting out on counters or in open bags.
  • Clean up spills immediately: Spilled food crumbs or leftover scraps can be a feast for rodents. Clean up any messes quickly and thoroughly.
  • Empty your trash regularly: Take out your trash regularly, especially kitchen bins, and ensure they have tight-fitting lids. Don’t leave overflowing bins outside your house.

4. Decluttering: Creating An Environment Unfriendly To Uninvited Guests:

Rodents love clutter! It provides them with hiding places and nesting materials. Here’s what you can do:

  • De-clutter your home: This includes removing piles of clothes, newspapers, boxes, or anything else that creates potential hiding spots for rodents.
  • Organize your storage areas: Keep basements, attics, and garages organized to eliminate potential rodent havens.
  • Store items properly: Don’t store cardboard boxes directly on the floor. Use shelves or place them on plastic containers to elevate them from the ground.

5. Install Door Sweeps And Screens: Adding Extra Layers Of Protection Against Rodents:

Door sweeps and screens offer an extra layer of protection against rodents. Here’s what you can do:

  • Install door sweeps: These sweep the floor as the door opens and closes, creating a barrier that prevents rodents from entering through the gap beneath the door.
  • Use window screens: Ensure all your windows have properly fitted screens to prevent rodents from entering through open windows.

Additional Tips: 

  • Consider setting humane traps indoors to catch any rodents that manage to get inside. However, remember to check and dispose of trapped rodents regularly.
  • If you have a fireplace, ensure the chimney flue is properly sealed when not in use.
  • Maintain your landscaping by trimming overgrown bushes and trees away from your house. This eliminates potential hiding places for rodents near your home.

Read Also: Signs of German Cockroach Infestation

Best Tools and Products for Keeping Rodents Away This Winter

Seal Up Your Fortress

Rodents are incredibly resourceful and can squeeze through surprisingly tiny gaps. Your first line of defence is to seal up any potential entry points. This includes:

  • Cracks and gaps: Inspect your foundation, walls, windows, and doors for any cracks or crevices larger than a quarter-inch. Use caulk or weather stripping to seal these up.
  • Vents and openings: Cover vents with hardware cloth to allow air circulation while preventing rodents from entering.
  • Pipes and utility lines: Check where pipes and utilities enter your home and seal any gaps around them with caulk or expanding foam.
  • Doors and windows: Ensure doors and windows close tightly without any gaps. Replace any damaged weather stripping or worn-out door sweeps.

Clean Up Your Food Sources:

  • Store food properly: Keep all food items, including pet food, in airtight containers made of glass or metal.
  • Clean up spills immediately: Don’t leave crumbs or food debris lying around,as even small amounts can attract rodents.
  • Manage your garbage: Use bins with tight-fitting lids and empty them regularly.

Eliminate Hiding Places:

  • Trim landscaping: Keep shrubs, bushes, and trees trimmed back at least 18 inches from your house. This removes potential hiding spots close to your entry points.
  • Store firewood properly: Stack firewood away from your house and off the ground.
  • Declutter your home: Avoid creating piles of clutter in your basement, attic,or garage, as these can provide nesting areas for rodents.

Utilize Repellents:

  • Natural rodent repellents: Peppermint, eucalyptus, and cayenne pepper oils are known to have rodent-repelling properties:
    • Dilute a few drops of essential oil in water and spray around potential entry points.
    • Place cotton balls soaked in these oils strategically throughout your home.
  • Commercial repellents: Consider using commercially available rodenticides or ultrasonic repellents. Always follow the manufacturer’s instructions carefully to ensure safe and effective use.

Traps

If you suspect a rodent infestation, consider setting traps. However, be aware that traps are not a long-term solution and should be used in conjunction with other preventative measures.

Remember: When dealing with an existing rodent infestation, it’s important to seek professional help from a licensed pest control company. They have the expertise and resources to safely and effectively eliminate the problem and prevent future infestations.

Conclusion

Imagine this: crackling fire, warm blankets, a steaming cup of your favourite beverage – the perfect picture of a cosy winter evening. Now imagine sharing this scene with unwelcome guests: scurrying rodents, gnawed wires, and the constant worry of disease. By taking the necessary steps outlined above, you can turn your vision of a delightful winter into a reality.

However, prevention is always better than cure. Don’t wait until you hear scratching noises in the attic or see droppings in the corner. Take action now to keep your home rodent-free and enjoy a peaceful, pest-free winter.

But what if you’re already facing a rodent problem?

Don’t worry; help is readily available. At 7 States Pest Control, we understand the stress and frustration associated with pest infestations. Our experienced and licensed professionals can provide comprehensive pest control services solutions tailored to your specific needs. We offer a range of safe and effective methods to eliminate existing rodent problems and prevent future infestations.

Contact us today for consultation in Melbourne and Perth and quote. Let us help you reclaim your home and enjoy a pest-free winter wonderland!

posts.title: Every Pest Has a Different Solution: Inside 7 States Pest Control’s Melbourne Treatment Methods
posts.excerpt: One of the most common mistakes homeowners and business owners make is treating every pest problem in the same way.  A quick spray or generic treatment may seem effective at first, but it often fails to address the real cause of the infestation. posts.content_html:
One of the most common mistakes homeowners and business owners make is treating every pest problem in the same way. 

A quick spray or generic treatment may seem effective at first, but it often fails to address the real cause of the infestation.

Melbourne properties face a wide variety of pest issues due to changing weather conditions, dense urban living, older building structures, and nearby green spaces. Ants, cockroaches, rodents, termites, spiders, and bed bugs all behave differently and require different treatment strategies. 

Using a single solution for every pest often leads to repeated infestations and unnecessary expense.

Targeted pest control focuses on identifying the pest, understanding how it behaves, and applying the correct treatment for that specific issue. This approach delivers longer-lasting results compared to general sprays that only provide short-term relief.

Why Pest Problems in Melbourne Need Targeted Solutions

Melbourne’s climate creates ideal conditions for many pest species throughout the year. 

Warm summers increase insect activity, while cooler months drive rodents and spiders indoors. High-density housing, construction activity, and food sources further contribute to pest pressure across residential and commercial properties.

Different pests behave in different ways:

  • Ants rely on scent trails and live in large colonies
  • Cockroaches hide in warm, damp areas and reproduce quickly
  • Rodents enter buildings through small gaps and nest in roof spaces
  • Termites feed on timber and cause structural damage
  • Spiders follow insect activity into homes
  • Bed bugs spread through furniture, luggage, and shared spaces

Because of these differences, searching for pest control near me should not result in a one-size-fits-all service. Proper pest control requires expert inspection and a targeted treatment plan designed for Melbourne conditions.

The Inspection-First Approach Used by Professional Pest Control Melbourne Experts

Effective pest control Melbourne services begin with inspection, not chemicals. Without a proper assessment, treatments often miss nesting areas, entry points, or the true extent of the infestation, leading to recurring pest problems.

A professional inspection helps to:

  • Identify the exact pest species present
  • Locate entry points and nesting sites
  • Assess the level of infestation
  • Select the most effective treatment method

By understanding the problem before treatment begins, inspection-led pest control reduces the risk of pests returning. This approach focuses on long-term results rather than temporary fixes.

Different Pests, Different Treatment Methods

Each pest requires a specific control method based on behaviour, risk, and environment. Below are the key pest control services offered, each suited to a different type of infestation.

Ant Pest Control – Stopping the Colony, Not Just the Trail

Spraying visible ants only removes workers, not the colony. Ant pest control focuses on locating nests, disrupting scent trails, and eliminating the source of the infestation to prevent ants from returning.

Cockroach Control – Eliminating Hidden Breeding Areas

Cockroaches pose hygiene risks and spread bacteria. They hide in cracks, drains, and appliances. Professional cockroach control uses gel baits and targeted treatments that reach breeding areas instead of relying on surface sprays.

Rodent Control in Melbourne – Removing the Cause, Not Just the Rodents

Rodents damage wiring, contaminate food, and create health risks. Rodent control involves identifying entry points, addressing nesting behaviour, and applying traps, exclusion methods, and long-term prevention strategies.

Spider Control Treatment – Reducing Webbing and Insect Activity

Spiders usually appear indoors because of increased insect activity. Spider control treatments focus on reducing insects, applying balanced interior and exterior treatments, and limiting conditions that attract spiders.

Bed Bug Treatment – Treating Every Life Stage

Bed bugs are difficult to eliminate because they spread easily and survive in multiple life stages. Bed bug treatment requires a multi-step process that targets eggs, nymphs, and adults, along with follow-up inspections to ensure full control.

Mosquito Pest Control

Mosquito pest control targets breeding areas and outdoor zones where mosquitoes thrive. Reducing standing water and applying targeted treatments helps lower mosquito populations around homes and businesses.

Fox Pest Control

Fox activity can cause property damage and safety concerns. Fox pest control focuses on humane deterrents, site assessments, and exclusion methods designed to reduce repeat activity

Mites Control

Mites can cause skin irritation and affect pets. Mites control begins with identifying the species and applying targeted indoor and outdoor treatments, followed by prevention advice to reduce recurrence.

Moth Control

Moths damage fabrics, carpets, and stored goods. Moth control treatments target larvae sources and storage areas while providing preventative solutions to protect clothing and materials.

Silverfish Treatment

Silverfish thrive in damp areas and damage paper and fabrics. Silverfish treatment focuses on moisture control, crack and crevice treatments, and long-term prevention measures.

Wasp Nest Removal Melbourne

Wasps are aggressive and pose safety risks. Professional wasp nest removal ensures safe elimination of nests while reducing the likelihood of future nesting.

Why DIY Pest Control Often Fails in Melbourne Homes

DIY pest control products are often less effective than professional treatments. Incorrect application can spread infestations or allow pests to develop resistance.

Common issues with DIY pest control include:

  • Temporary relief without addressing the source
  • Pests adapting to over-the-counter chemicals
  • Infestations spreading deeper into the property
  • Delayed professional intervention increasing costs

Residential vs Commercial Pest Control – Why the Method Changes

Residential and commercial properties require different pest control strategies. Homes prioritise safety for families and pets, while commercial sites must meet compliance and hygiene standards. Customised plans ensure effective control without disruption.

What “Pest Control Near Me” Should Really Mean

Choosing pest control near you should involve more than location. It should include fast response times, local knowledge of Melbourne pest trends, and reliable follow-up support to ensure treatments remain effective.

Long-Term Prevention, Not One-Time Treatments

Effective pest control includes preventative measures such as sealing entry points, ongoing monitoring, seasonal treatments, and practical advice for property owners. These steps help reduce future infestations.

Why Choosing the Right Pest Control Melbourne Service Matters

Professional pest control protects health, property value, and long-term maintenance costs. Correct treatment from the start reduces repeat infestations and provides confidence that the problem has been properly addressed.

One Property, Many Pests, One Smart Approach

Every pest problem requires a different solution. Inspection-led, targeted treatments deliver better outcomes than general sprays. Professional pest control Melbourne services focus on prevention, accuracy, and long-term results rather than short-term fixes.

At 7 States Pest Control, every job begins with a detailed inspection to understand the specific pest issue affecting your property.

Their Melbourne-based team focuses on identifying pest behaviour, entry points, and infestation levels before recommending treatment. This inspection-led approach helps apply the right solution the first time, reducing repeat infestations. 

Treatments are tailored for homes, rentals, and commercial spaces, keeping safety and effectiveness in mind.

With a focus on prevention and long-term control, 7 States Pest Control delivers reliable pest control Melbourne services backed by local experience.

posts.content_html:
Melbourne’s sunshine beckons you outdoors, but wasps – can turn your backyard paradise into a buzzing battleground. Their stings inflict not just pain but also pose a significant health hazard for individuals with allergies.

If you’ve spotted a wasp nest lurking on your property, don’t attempt to remove it yourself. Trying to tackle a wasp nest yourself poses a significant risk. Here at 7 States Pest Control, we understand the importance of safe and effective wasp nest removal in Melbourne.

Signs You Need to Call Professional Wasp Nest Removal

Summer in most places means sunshine, barbecues, and enjoying the outdoors. But in Melbourne, These buzzing insects may seem harmless, but their stings are painful, and for allergy sufferers, they can be a serious health risk.

The worst part? Wasps don’t build their nests out in the open – they prefer hidden spots like eaves, wall cavities, or under decks.  So, how do you know if you have a wasp problem lurking unseen? Here are some key signs that it’s time to call in professional wasp nest removal:

  • Spotted a Wasp Nest: The most obvious sign? Seeing the actual nest! These papery, gray structures are typically round or oval-shaped and can be tucked away in eaves, wall cavities, under decks, or even in attics. Keep your eyes peeled, especially in shadowy areas.
  • Increased Wasp Activity: Are you noticing more wasps buzzing around your property than usual? This sudden surge in activity could indicate a nearby nest, with the wasps coming and going to gather food and care for their young.
  • Unexplained Stings: Even a single sting is a red flag. Wasps are generally not aggressive unless they feel threatened. If you’ve been stung and can’t explain it, there’s a good chance a nest is hidden nearby, waiting to be disturbed.
  • Unusual Noises: If you hear a persistent buzzing sound coming from within your walls or cavities, it might be wasps constructing or residing in a nest. This is a definite sign to call in the professionals before the problem escalates.

Why Choose Professional Wasp Nest Removal?

While a lone wasp might seem like a minor nuisance, it’s often a sign of a bigger problem: a hidden wasp nest lurking nearby. These nests, typically constructed of papery grey material, can be tucked away in eaves, wall cavities, or under decks.  Ignoring them is a recipe for trouble, and attempting DIY wasp nest removal can be dangerous. Here’s why opting for professional help is the smarter and safer choice:

  • Aggressive Stings: Wasps are highly territorial and will readily attack anyone who comes near their nest, potentially inflicting multiple painful stings.
  • Hidden Danger Zones: Nests are often tucked away in eaves, wall cavities, or under decks – making them difficult to locate and remove safely without proper equipment and knowledge.
  • Trained Professionals: Our technicians are specifically trained in safe wasp nest removal methods. They have the knowledge and experience to locate, access, and eliminate nests efficiently, minimizing risk.
  • The Right Tools for the Job: Professional wasp nest removal involves specialized equipment like protective gear, long-range insecticides, and nest removal tools. DIY methods often lack the effectiveness or safety of these professional tools.
  • Timely Response: A wasp problem requires a quick and efficient solution. Professional services ensure a prompt response, minimizing the disruption to your life and eliminating the wasp threat swiftly.
  • Complete Nest Removal: Incomplete DIY attempts can leave behind angry wasps and the potential for future problems. Professionals ensure complete nest removal, eliminating the threat entirely.

Don’t wait until a wasp sting sends you running for cover. If you suspect a wasp nest on your property, contact 7 States Pest Control today! We offer safe, effective, and guaranteed wasp nest removal services in Melbourne.

Let our experts handle the wasps – and reclaim your outdoor haven!

posts.title: Facing a Pest Problem in Your Melbourne Café? Here’s What You Need to Know
posts.excerpt: Running a café or restaurant in Melbourne is about much more than good food and friendly service. Customers expect clean surroundings, a safe dining environment, and strict hygiene standards. Unfortunately, pests can threaten all of this in a matter of days. Even a minor issue with rodents, cockroaches, or flies
posts.content_html:
Running a café or restaurant in Melbourne is about much more than good food and friendly service. Customers expect clean surroundings, a safe dining environment, and strict hygiene standards. Unfortunately, pests can threaten all of this in a matter of days. Even a minor issue with rodents, cockroaches, or flies can put customer health at risk, harm your reputation, and attract unwanted attention from health inspectors.

This is why professional pest removal Melbourne services are not just a convenience but a necessity. By engaging experts, cafés and restaurants can ensure compliance with food safety regulations, protect customer trust, and avoid expensive damage to stock or premises.

Why Pests Are a Big Threat to Cafés and Restaurants

Hospitality businesses provide the perfect conditions for pests. Warm kitchens, food scraps, and constant foot traffic create easy opportunities for infestations to develop. While some pests may seem small or harmless at first, their impact on food businesses can be devastating.

Common café and restaurant pests in Melbourne

  • Rodents (rats and mice): These pests are notorious for chewing through packaging, leaving droppings, and spreading diseases such as salmonella. They can also cause serious structural damage by gnawing on wiring and fittings.

  • Cockroaches: Thriving in warm, damp areas, cockroaches contaminate surfaces and food while spreading bacteria. Their presence can quickly result in failed inspections.

  • Flies: Small but extremely disruptive, flies carry germs and contaminate exposed food. In an open café or dining area, a fly infestation can cause immediate customer complaints.

  • Ants: While less frightening than rodents or cockroaches, ants can invade kitchens and food storage areas, attracted to sugar and grease.

Risks posed by pests

  • Contaminated food and drinks.
  • Spread of harmful bacteria and diseases.
  • Food spoilage leading to stock losses.
  • Customer dissatisfaction and negative reviews.
  • Health inspection failures, fines, or temporary closure.

A single sighting of a pest in your café can be enough to damage your reputation and reduce customer confidence. In today’s competitive food industry, that is a risk no business can afford.

Signs Your Café Might Have a Pest Problem

Spotting an infestation early can save café and restaurant owners from costly damage and potential closure. Here are some of the most common warning signs:

  • Droppings and gnawed packaging: A clear indication of rodents in food storage or kitchen areas.

  • Grease marks and smear trails: Rodents and cockroaches often leave tracks along skirting boards and behind appliances.

  • Unpleasant odours: A strong, musky smell may indicate pests nesting nearby.

  • Strange noises: Scratching or squeaking sounds after hours are a red flag for rodent activity.

  • Visible pests during the day: If pests are spotted in daylight, it usually means a large infestation is already present.

  • Customer complaints: Diners noticing pests is a serious signal that immediate action is required.

Ignoring these signs only allows the problem to grow. Early action is always more cost-effective than emergency pest control when infestations get out of hand.

Professional Pest Removal in Melbourne: Why It’s Essential

Many business owners attempt do-it-yourself pest control solutions, from over-the-counter sprays to traps. While these methods may temporarily reduce visible pests, they rarely eliminate the source of the problem.

Why DIY pest control fails in cafés

  • Surface sprays do not reach hidden nests or breeding areas.
  • Inconsistent application leaves gaps for pests to survive.
  • Unsafe chemicals can contaminate food or compromise customer safety.
  • Pests often adapt to household treatments, returning in greater numbers.

Benefits of hiring experts

  • Targeted solutions: Professional pest technicians identify the root cause and tailor treatments to your café’s needs.
  • Safe methods: Food-safe, eco-friendly pest control techniques protect both customers and staff.
  • Compliance assurance: Professional pest removal ensures your café meets Melbourne’s food safety requirements.
  • Long-term prevention: Expert services focus not only on eliminating current pests but also on preventing future infestations.

Five Signs That Indicate You Need Mice Pest Control In Melbourne
