posts.content_html:
Rodents like rats and mice are more than just a nuisance in Melbourne homes and businesses. 

They can cause significant damage, spread diseases, and create unsafe living or working conditions. 

If you’ve noticed signs of rodents, such as droppings, chewed wires, or strange noises, acting quickly is essential. 

Professional rodent control services in Melbourne can help you tackle infestations effectively and prevent future problems.

In this blog, we’ll explore why rodent control is critical, the risks of ignoring an infestation, and how expert pest control services can safeguard your property. 

Whether you’re a homeowner, business owner, landlord, or real estate buyer, understanding the importance of timely rodent control can save you time, money, and stress.

Why Rodent Control Matters in Melbourne

Melbourne’s diverse climate and urban environment make it a hotspot for rodent activity. 

Rats and mice thrive in areas with easy access to food, water, and shelter, which is why they’re commonly found in homes, restaurants, offices, and rental properties. Here’s why addressing rodent issues promptly is crucial:

  • Health Risks: Rodents carry diseases like leptospirosis, salmonella, and hantavirus, which can spread through droppings, urine, or contaminated surfaces.
  • Property Damage: Rats and mice chew through electrical wires, insulation, and wooden structures, leading to costly repairs or even fire hazards.
  • Reputation Damage: For businesses, especially in hospitality or retail, a rodent sighting can harm your reputation and drive customers away.
  • Legal Compliance: Landlords and business owners must maintain pest-free environments to meet health and safety regulations.

By investing in professional rodent control services in Melbourne, you can protect your health, property, and reputation while ensuring compliance with local standards.

Signs You Need Rodent Control Services

Spotting a rodent problem early can prevent a small issue from becoming a full-blown infestation. Here are common signs to watch for:

  1. Droppings: Small, dark droppings near food sources, cabinets, or corners are a clear indicator of rodent activity.
  2. Gnaw Marks: Chewed wires, furniture, or packaging suggest rodents are active in your property.
  3. Noises: Scratching or scurrying sounds in walls or ceilings, especially at night, are a red flag.
  4. Nests: Shredded paper, fabric, or insulation in hidden areas may indicate a rodent nest.
  5. Unusual Pet Behaviour: Pets acting agitated or sniffing specific areas could mean they’ve detected rodents.

If you notice any of these signs, don’t wait. Contact a trusted pest control provider to assess and address the issue before it worsens.

The Risks of Ignoring a Rodent Problem

Some people assume a single rat or mouse isn’t a big deal, but rodents multiply quickly. A small problem can spiral out of control in weeks. Here’s what could happen if you ignore the first signs of rodents:

  • Rapid Infestation: A single pair of rodents can produce dozens of offspring in a year, leading to a large-scale problem.
  • Increased Costs: The longer an infestation persists, the more damage rodents cause, resulting in higher repair and pest control costs.
  • Health Hazards: Prolonged exposure to rodent droppings or urine increases the risk of illness for you, your family, or employees.
  • Business Losses: For businesses, rodent sightings can lead to negative reviews, lost customers, and even temporary closures.

Taking action at the first sign of trouble is the best way to avoid these risks. 

Why Choose Professional Rodent Control in Melbourne?

While DIY methods like traps or baits may seem tempting, they often fail to address the root of the problem. Professional pest control services provide long-term solutions with several benefits:

  • Expert Assessment: Trained technicians identify entry points, nesting areas, and the extent of the infestation.
  • Safe and Effective Methods: Professionals use industry-approved treatments that are safe for humans and pets but highly effective against rodents.
  • Preventive Measures: Beyond removal, pest control experts seal entry points and offer advice to keep rodents out.
  • Customised Solutions: Whether you’re a homeowner, landlord, or business owner, services are tailored to your property’s needs.
  • Compliance: For businesses and landlords, professional services ensure you meet health and safety regulations.

By choosing a reputable pest control provider, you can trust that your rodent problem will be handled efficiently and safely.

Rodent Control for Different Audiences in Melbourne

Rodent issues affect various groups in Melbourne, from homeowners to real estate buyers. Here’s how professional rodent control services cater to each:

Homeowners

Rodents in your home can endanger your family’s health and damage your property. Professional pest control ensures a safe living environment and protects your investment.

Business Owners

Restaurants, cafes, and retail stores can’t afford the reputational damage caused by rodents. Pest control services help maintain a clean, compliant, and customer-friendly space.

Real Estate Buyers/Renters

Before buying or renting a property, ensure it’s pest-free. Rodent control services provide inspections and treatments to give you confidence in your decision.

Health-Conscious Individuals

If you prioritise wellness, you’ll want a rodent-free environment to avoid diseases and contamination. Professional services use safe, eco-friendly methods to align with your values.

Landlords

As a landlord, you’re responsible for maintaining a safe and habitable property. Regular pest control prevents tenant complaints and ensures compliance with regulations.

How to Prevent Future Rodent Infestations

Once your rodent problem is under control, taking preventive steps can keep them from returning. Here are some practical tips:

  1. Seal Entry Points: Check for gaps around doors, windows, pipes, and vents, and seal them with caulk or steel wool.
  2. Store Food Properly: Keep food in airtight containers and avoid leaving pet food or crumbs out overnight.
  3. Maintain Cleanliness: Regularly clean kitchens, pantries, and dining areas to remove food sources that attract rodents.
  4. Trim Vegetation: Keep trees and shrubs trimmed away from your property to reduce rodent hiding spots.
  5. Schedule Regular Inspections: Work with a pest control provider for routine checks to catch problems early

Why Melbourne’s Climate Makes Rodent Control Essential?

Melbourne’s weather, with its mild winters and warm summers, creates ideal conditions for rodents to thrive. 

Rats and mice seek shelter indoors during cooler months, making homes and businesses prime targets. 

Additionally, Melbourne’s mix of urban and suburban areas provides ample food sources, from restaurant bins to household pantries.

Professional rodent control services in Melbourne are designed to tackle these local challenges. By understanding the city’s unique environment, pest control experts can deliver targeted solutions that work.

Protect Your Property Today

posts.content_html:
Operating a café or restaurant in Melbourne means working in an environment where food safety, cleanliness, and customer trust are under constant scrutiny. 

With regular council inspections, strict food safety regulations, and a competitive hospitality industry, even minor hygiene concerns can have serious consequences. One issue that is often overlooked by food businesses is spider activity.

This blog explains why cafés and restaurants in Melbourne face higher spider risks, the problems spiders can cause, and how professional spider control helps protect hygiene, reputation, and compliance.

Why Pest Control Is Critical for Cafés & Restaurants in Melbourne

Food businesses are particularly vulnerable because of:

posts.title: Why Your DIY Traps Aren’t Working: The Reality of Rodent Control in Melbourne
posts.excerpt: Living in Melbourne is great—until you hear that tell-tale scratching in the walls at 2:00 AM. posts.content_html:
Living in Melbourne is great—until you hear that tell-tale scratching in the walls at 2:00 AM. Whether you’re in a leafy suburb like Camberwell or a compact apartment in the CBD, rodents are an unfortunate part of city life. When most people realize they have a visitor, their first instinct is to run to the local hardware store, grab a pack of wooden traps, and maybe some bright blue pellets.

There is a common belief that rodent control in Melbourne is a simple “do it yourself” weekend project. But if you’ve ever tried it, you know that catching one mouse rarely solves the problem. Today, we’re going to bust the myths surrounding DIY pest control and look at what actually works to keep your home safe.

The “One and Done” Myth

Why do so many of us believe we can handle a rodent infestation on our own? It usually comes down to what we see in old cartoons. We think if we catch the “one” mouse we saw scuttling across the kitchen floor, the battle is over.

In reality, rodents are social creatures. If you see one, there are likely ten more hiding in the insulation, under the floorboards, or behind your kitchen cabinets. Using a couple of supermarket traps is like trying to put out a house fire with a water pistol. It might look like you’re doing something, but the real problem is still growing out of sight.

The Problem with “Supermarket” Solutions

One of the biggest issues with DIY melbourne rodent control is the quality of the products available to the general public. While those colorful boxes of bait look effective, they often cause more problems than they solve.

  1. The Danger to Our Local Wildlife

Melbourne is home to beautiful native animals, from possums to the majestic Powerful Owl. When you use cheap, slow-acting poisons from the shop, the rodent doesn’t die instantly. It becomes weak and slow, making it an easy snack for a pet dog or a local bird of prey. This leads to “secondary poisoning,” where the animal that eats the rat also gets sick or dies.

  1. Rats Are Smarter Than You Think

Believe it or not, rats are highly suspicious of anything new in their environment. This is called “neophobia.” If a DIY trap doesn’t work perfectly the first time, or if a bait makes a rat feel slightly sick without killing it, they learn. They will tell the rest of the colony to avoid that specific spot or smell. This makes future rodent removal services in Melbourne much harder because the pests have been “trained” to avoid traps.

  1. The Breeding Machine

A single pair of mice can have dozens of babies in just a few months. While you’re waiting for your supermarket trap to click, three new litters could be born on your roof. Professional mouse pest control Melbourne services focus on stopping the breeding cycle, not just catching the “brave” ones that come out into the open.

The Professional Secret: Exclusion Over Elimination

If you talk to a real expert in pest control Melbourne rats, they will tell you that killing the rats is actually the last step. The most important part is making sure they can’t get back in.

Smart practitioners use a method called “Exclusion.” This means they spend time walking around your house looking for tiny gaps. Did you know a mouse can squeeze through a hole the size of a ballpoint pen? Or that a rat can chew through soft wood and plastic?

Professionals use heavy-duty materials like steel wool, metal mesh, and specialized sealants that rodents simply cannot chew through. When you hire a professional for rodent pest control in Melbourne, you aren’t just paying for traps; you’re paying for someone to “rodent-proof” your home.

How Different Areas Approach the Problem

It’s interesting to see how pest control changes depending on where you live. While we focus on rodent control in Melbourne, other parts of Australia have different challenges:

  • Victoria: Our focus is heavily on protecting native birds and pets from toxic baits.
  • New South Wales: Often deals with larger urban rat populations in high-density areas.
  • Queensland: Focuses on rodents that thrive in humid, tropical climates.
  • Western Australia: Deals with specific pests that interfere with grain and farming.
  • South Australia: Has unique rules about humane trapping.
  • Tasmania: Focuses on preventing mainland pests from disrupting their island ecosystem.
  • Northern Territory: Deals with rodents that are active in extreme heat and wet seasons.

In Melbourne, because our weather can go from sun to rain in ten minutes, rodents are always looking for a warm, dry place to hide—which is usually your ceiling!

Spotlight: 7 States Pest Control

When looking for reliable Melbourne rodent control, local expertise matters. 7 States Pest Control has become a trusted name for families and businesses across the city. They specialize in managing the unique challenges of Melbourne’s urban environment—from high-density CBD apartments to sprawling suburban homes.

What sets them apart is their commitment to safe, eco-friendly methods. They don’t just throw chemicals at the problem; they offer a comprehensive range of services including:

  • Targeted Rodent Proofing: Sealing entry points to prevent future infestations.
  • Pet and Child-Safe Treatments: Ensuring your loved ones are protected while the pests are eliminated.
  • 24/7 Emergency Support: Because rodent problems don’t always happen during business hours.

Whether you need mice pest control melbourne or a full-scale commercial plan, their team focuses on long-term prevention rather than just a quick fix.

For trusted pest control Melbourne services, we deliver complete pest solutions. Our offerings include spider control services and expert spider removal service. We also cover fox population control and possum removal service Melbourne. Ensure complete protection with our termite control Melbourne and long-lasting termite treatment Melbourne.

What Are People Asking?

Thanks to AI and search engines, people are getting more curious about how to handle pests safely. Here are some of the most common things Melburnians are asking:

  • “How do I get rid of rats without hurting my cat?”
  • “Are those plug-in ultrasonic repellers actually worth the money?” (Spoilers: Usually not!)
  • “What is the difference between a roof rat and a Norway rat?”
  • “Why do I still hear scratching after I put out bait?”

These questions show that people are tired of “quick fixes” and want real, long-term results for mice pest control Melbourne.

What Should You Do Instead?

If you suspect you have a rodent problem, don’t panic, but don’t wait either. Here is a simple plan that actually works:

  1. Clean Up the Buffet

Rodents stay because there is food. Make sure your bins are sealed, pet food isn’t left out overnight, and your pantry items are in hard plastic or glass containers.

  1. Check the Perimeter 

Take a walk around your house. Look for gaps around pipes, under doors, or near the vents. If you see light coming through a gap, a mouse can get through it.

  1. Call the Pros Early

The longer you wait, the more expensive the problem becomes. A professional rodent removal service in Melbourne has the tools to find the nest, identify the entry points, and use baits that are targeted and safe for the environment.

At the end of the day, your home should be your sanctuary. You shouldn’t have to share it with uninvited guests that chew on your wires and leave messes in your kitchen.

While the DIY route seems cheaper at first, the cost of ruined insulation, chewed electrical cables, and endless boxes of ineffective traps adds up quickly. By choosing professional pest control Melbourne rats and mice services, you’re investing in your peace of mind and the safety of your family (including the furry ones).

Don’t let a small problem turn into a big headache. Let’s keep Melbourne homes rodent-free, one house at a time. 

If you’re tired of the DIY struggle, reach out to an expert who understands the unique challenges of Melbourne rodent control. Your sleep—and your walls—will thank you!

posts.excerpt: Rodent infestations are often thought of as isolated issues.  If your home is clean, you might assume you’re safe. But in many Melbourne suburbs, especially in closely built neighbourhoods, that assumption can quickly backfire. Rodents are highly mobile and adaptable. posts.content_html:
Rodent infestations are often thought of as isolated issues. 

If your home is clean, you might assume you’re safe. But in many Melbourne suburbs, especially in closely built neighbourhoods, that assumption can quickly backfire.

Rodents are highly mobile and adaptable. They don’t care about fences, property boundaries, or brick walls. 

In fact, your neighbour’s pest problem can silently become your own—often without warning. 

Rats and mice can easily travel from one property to the next, looking for food, warmth, and shelter. If a nearby house is dealing with an infestation, your property could be at risk.

In this blog , we’ll uncover how rodents move between homes, why Melbourne is especially vulnerable, and what signs to watch out for. 

We’ll also cover the health and property risks they bring, the limitations of DIY control, and how professional rodent pest control in Melbourne can protect your home.

How Rodents Spread from Property to Property

Rodents are opportunistic and resourceful. 

They can enter a home through gaps as small as a 20-cent coin and often use structures and landscaping features to move between properties.

Common Entry Pathways Include:

  • Shared walls or attics in duplexes, apartments, or townhouses
  • Air vents, pipes, and drainage systems that connect multiple homes
  • Overgrown trees and vines that provide rooftop access
  • Fences, garages, and sheds that act as bridges or nesting sites

Once rodents are established in one area, they’re likely to spread. They explore nearby environments for food or to escape overcrowded nests.

Nesting Behaviour in Melbourne Suburbs

Melbourne’s urban and suburban layouts offer ideal conditions for rodent nesting. 

Roof voids, wall cavities, underfloor spaces, and backyard clutter provide warmth and shelter. 

Rodents tend to reproduce rapidly, and if conditions in one home become inhospitable—due to renovations, pest control, or resource scarcity—they’ll move on to the next available space.

Example: In a Brunswick home, rodents entered after the neighbours started a kitchen renovation. 

The disturbance drove the rats into nearby properties, where they found easy access through a shared roof space. Within days, the new occupants reported scratching noises and droppings—signs that the problem had migrated.

Why Melbourne Homes Are at High Risk

Melbourne’s climate, infrastructure, and lifestyle make it a hotspot for rodent activity.

Key Contributing Factors:

  • Cooler months: As temperatures drop, rodents seek warmth indoors, leading to seasonal spikes in infestations.
  • Construction and development: Ongoing urban development displaces rodents, driving them to relocate to surrounding areas.
  • Inadequate garbage disposal: Improper garbage disposal, especially in laneways or apartment complexes, can attract rodents and lead to infestations.
  • High-density living: More homes close together means more nesting opportunities and faster spread between properties.

Rodents thrive in environments where shelter, food, and water are readily available—and Melbourne’s suburban sprawl often ticks all the boxes.

According to local council data, inner-city areas like Carlton, Fitzroy, and Northcote consistently report high numbers of rodent complaints during winter months.

Signs You Might Already Have Rodents

Rodents are nocturnal and secretive. By the time you notice them, they may have been nesting for weeks.

Common Indicators:

  • Droppings: Small, dark pellets in pantries, cupboards, or along baseboards.
  • Chewed wires or insulation: A serious fire hazard that often occurs in roof spaces.
  • Scratching or scurrying sounds: Especially at night, in walls or ceilings.
  • Musty odours: Caused by rodent urine or decaying materials near nests.
  • Grease marks: Rodents follow the same paths repeatedly, leaving dark smudges on walls and floors.

If you detect even one of these signs, it’s important to act quickly. Rodents reproduce rapidly, and a small problem can escalate fast.

A professional inspection can identify hidden nests, track movement patterns, and assess the extent of the infestation.

Health and Property Risks of Rodents

Beyond being a nuisance, rodents pose significant health and safety risks. Their presence can jeopardise your well-being and damage your home.

Health Concerns:

  • Leptospirosis, salmonella, and hantavirus can be transmitted through urine, droppings, and contaminated surfaces.
  • Rodents may carry fleas, mites, and ticks that spread additional diseases.
  • Droppings and dander can aggravate asthma and allergies, particularly in children.

Property Damage:

  • Electrical fires from chewed wires are a real danger in rodent-infested homes.
  • Structural damage to insulation, ductwork, and wall cavities is common.
  • Contamination of food and pantry items can lead to costly wastage.

Early intervention can help minimize these risks, protect your home’s value, and prevent long-term health issues.

Why DIY Isn’t Enough for Rodent Control

It’s tempting to reach for traps or poison at the first sign of rodents—but DIY solutions rarely solve the problem completely.

Limitations of DIY Rodent Control:

  • Short-term fixes: Traps may catch one or two rodents but don’t address the nest or entry points.
  • Health risks: Store-bought poisons can be harmful to pets and children if misused.
  • Incomplete coverage: Without understanding rodent behaviour, it’s easy to miss hidden nests or access points.

Rodent control requires an integrated approach: eliminating current infestations, sealing entryways, and preventing future access. This level of thoroughness is difficult to achieve without professional help.

How 7 States Pest Control Can Help

When rodents take over, professional help is essential. At 7 States Pest Control, we offer a comprehensive approach tailored to Melbourne homes.

Our Rodent Control Services Include:

  • Detailed inspections: We locate nests, identify entry points, and assess risk areas.
    Safe and eco-friendly treatments: Designed to eliminate rodents without harming your household.
  • Experienced technicians: Our team knows Melbourne’s rodent hotspots and building styles.
  • Fast response times and flexible scheduling: We act quickly to minimise damage and prevent further spread.

Whether you’re in a standalone home, townhouse, or apartment complex, we’ll help you regain control with long-term solutions.

Preventing a Shared Problem: What You and Your Neighbours Can Do

Rodent control is most effective when everyone in the area takes part. Since rodents can travel easily between homes, collaboration is key.

What You Can Do:

  • Talk to your neighbours if you notice rodent activity.
  • Keep outdoor spaces free of rubbish, pet food, and water sources.
  • Trim trees and bushes that touch roofs or fences.
  • Seal entry points like holes in walls, vents, and foundations.
  • Encourage your body corporate or landlord to conduct regular inspections.

Don’t Wait Until It’s Your Problem

Rodents are not just a nuisance—they’re a serious risk to your home, health, and peace of mind. And in tightly built Melbourne suburbs, your neighbour’s pest problem could be closer to home than you think. 

The earlier you act, the easier it is to stop an infestation in its tracks with rodent pest control Melbourne.

Book a professional inspection today with 7 States Pest Control and take the first step toward a rodent-free home.

posts.content_html:
Wasp infestations are a growing concern for many Melbourne businesses, particularly during the warmer months when wasp activity is at its peak. While often mistaken as a minor pest issue, the presence of wasps and their nests in or around office buildings can pose serious threats to both employee wellbeing and daily business operations.

From painful stings to the risk of allergic reactions and workplace disruptions, wasps are not a problem to ignore. That’s why wasp control Melbourne services are critical for maintaining a safe, functional, and comfortable working environment.

This blog will walk you through how to identify signs of a wasp problem, understand the risks involved, and explore effective solutions designed specifically for Melbourne offices.

Common Signs of Wasp Infestation in Offices

Wasps tend to build nests in quiet, undisturbed areas, which makes commercial buildings a common target. Recognising the early signs of an infestation can prevent larger problems down the track.

  1. Visible Wasp Nests

Nests may appear as papery, dome-shaped structures attached to ceilings, roof eaves, corners of windows, or even inside wall cavities. Outdoor areas such as balconies, garden beds, sheds, or car parks may also serve as nesting sites.

  1. Increased Wasp Activity

If you’re noticing more wasps than usual hovering near windows, doors, or rubbish bins, it could be a sign of a nearby nest. Wasps are often drawn to food sources, especially sugary drinks and food scraps left outdoors.

  1. Staff Reports of Sightings or Stings

Employees may report wasp sightings near workstations or communal areas. In some cases, they may be stung, which is not only painful but could also result in serious allergic reactions for some individuals.

Early detection is key — don’t wait until a staff member is harmed before taking action.

Risks Associated with Wasp Nests in Offices

Underestimating a wasp infestation can have consequences beyond just nuisance. A workplace with active wasp activity poses several health and safety risks.

Health Risks

Wasp stings can be extremely painful and, in some cases, life-threatening. People with allergies may experience severe reactions, such as anaphylaxis, which requires immediate medical attention. Even for those without allergies, multiple stings can cause swelling, pain, and infection.

Workplace Safety Hazards

Wasps flying inside an office environment can cause panic and sudden movements. This may result in accidents, especially in areas with stairs, machinery, or sharp tools. Employees might avoid certain sections of the office, which can lead to unsafe or inefficient workflows.

Productivity Concerns

Fear of wasps can make employees feel uneasy, distracted, or reluctant to move freely around the workplace. This has a direct impact on morale and productivity. No employee wants to worry about a potential sting while trying to meet deadlines or attend meetings.

Effective Wasp Control Solutions in Melbourne

If you’re dealing with a wasp problem at your office, the best course of action is to seek professional help. Attempting DIY removal is not only unsafe but often ineffective in the long run.

Professional Wasp Nest Removal Services

Professional pest control technicians are trained to locate nests, assess the threat, and safely remove them using commercial-grade tools and treatments. Our Wasp Nest Removal Melbourne service ensures minimal disruption to your operations while eliminating the problem at its source.

We offer flexible appointments, discreet service, and complete compliance with health and safety regulations for commercial properties.

Preventive Measures

Ongoing prevention is just as important as removal. Implementing simple yet effective preventive steps can help reduce the risk of future infestations:

  • Seal any gaps, cracks, or openings around windows, doors, or roof tiles that could allow wasps to enter.
  • Install insect screens and ensure bins are tightly sealed and emptied regularly.
  • Arrange scheduled pest inspections, particularly in high-risk seasons.

Eco-Friendly Treatment Options

Many businesses are now looking for environmentally friendly solutions. We use non-toxic and low-impact treatments wherever possible, ensuring the safety of your employees, clients, and the surrounding environment. These methods are particularly suitable for offices, shared workspaces, and corporate buildings where safety and compliance are paramount.

Why Choose Professional Wasp Control Services

When dealing with wasps, experience matters. A professional pest control provider not only offers a more efficient solution but also ensures long-term protection.

Expertise in Wasp Identification

Different wasp species have different nesting habits and threat levels. A trained technician can identify the species and determine the most effective treatment method accordingly.

Safe Tools and Chemicals

We use commercial-grade tools and approved chemicals that are safe for indoor and outdoor use in commercial environments. Attempting to remove a nest yourself with off-the-shelf sprays can aggravate the insects and cause them to attack.

Reduced Office Disruption

Our services are designed to be as non-invasive as possible. We’ll work around your operating hours and provide quick, effective treatment to ensure your office can continue running smoothly.

Tips to Prevent Future Wasp Infestations

After removal, it’s important to take steps to ensure wasps don’t return. Here are some simple strategies to help keep your office wasp-free:

Conduct Regular Inspections

Schedule periodic professional inspections to detect nests early. Inspect common problem areas such as roof voids, gutters, and outdoor spaces.

Maintain Clean Outdoor Areas

Wasps are attracted to food and drink residue. Make sure outdoor break areas are kept clean, bins are emptied regularly, and food waste is disposed of correctly.

Educate Employees

Encourage employees to report wasp sightings immediately. Early reporting can prevent a minor issue from turning into a major infestation.

You can also educate your team on how to behave calmly around wasps to avoid provoking stings.

Wasp infestations can pose serious challenges for Melbourne offices — from health risks and workplace hazards to reduced productivity. 

Taking early action with a professional solution is the most effective way to ensure the safety and comfort of your team.

As a locally operated company, 7 States understands the unique pest challenges faced by offices and commercial properties across Melbourne’s suburbs and CBD.

With a strong track record in servicing offices, retail stores, industrial facilities, and shared workspaces, 7 States Pest Control  provides peace of mind through 24/7 support, fast response times, and customised treatment plans tailored to your business environment. For broader pest management needs, their office pest control services offer comprehensive solutions to ensure your entire workspace stays pest-free year-round.
